summary: First-run E2E test of SCADA HMI Builder. Backend: 24/25 pytest passing (auth, meta, projects CRUD, ownership isolation, devices for S7/Omron/Modbus, invalid address rejection, offline detection, tag format max_chars for INT16/UINT16/INT32/UINT32 & decimals recompute, runtime values/history/alarms, publish + public runtime, read-only 403, uploads good+bad). Frontend: login OK, projects list, config page shows PLC + 8 live tags with updating values, editor loads with 18 palette items and save/publish/add-screen controls, public /view/<slug> runtime renders live gauges, tank, pump toggle, setpoint, trend, active alarm; LAPORAN sub-screen renders 30-min history trend, CSV data record, alarm history with ACK.

minor.issue: FLOAT32 with decimals=2 returns max_chars=9 (sign+5int+dot+2dec), but review spec requested 8. Formula in backend/formats.py: int_digits = digits(7) - dec(2) = 5 -> 5+2+1(dot)+1(sign)=9. Spec likely wanted int_digits capped so integer part = digits(7) - dec(2) - 1(dot) = 4, giving 8. Decide whether digits budget should include the decimal point.

issues: Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount before container has size; add minWidth/minHeight or defer render until measured.

action_items: Decide on FLOAT32 max_chars policy: current backend returns 9 for FLOAT32 dec=2; problem statement expected 8. Adjust spec_for() in backend/formats.py (subtract 1 from digits when a decimal point is present) if 8 is desired, and update UI expectations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 541 lines with many concerns (auth, projects, devices, tags, runtime, uploads) - consider splitting into routers/{auth,projects,devices,tags,runtime,uploads}.py for maintainability.

auth.py hash uses bcrypt (starts with $2b$) - good. httpOnly Secure SameSite=None cookies set correctly. Login lockout after 5 attempts implemented. seed_admin idempotent and updates password if changed - matches playbook.
CORS uses explicit FRONTEND_URL + http://localhost:3000 with allow_credentials=True - correct.
Login attempts collection lacks TTL index; identifier records will grow indefinitely - consider TTL on locked_until or last_attempt_at.
engine.py auto-restart on load_config: creating many devices could trigger frequent full reloads; acceptable for MVP.
make_rt_router mounts twice for private/public - public write correctly gated by allow_operate; verified with 403 test.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed TEST_ auto-cleaned in fixtures; a temp test project TEST_isolate and TEST_proj get created and deleted. Register creates user + demo project (persists in db).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Admin login + seeded 'Demo Pengolahan Air' with slug jmn2xhqzzti already published. Simulator engine runs; history/alarms populated within seconds. Real driver connections cannot succeed in cloud - only simulator mode. FLOAT32 max_chars policy discrepancy is the only unresolved item.
